title: The Stand Presents: Mark Normand, Caitlin Peluffo, Matthew Broussard, & More!
description: Mark Normand headlines a Wednesday in the main room with Caitlin Peluffo, Matthew Broussard and Sahib Singh — the room where the tightest hour of the week tends to land.

poster.alt: The Stand Presents: Mark Normand, Caitlin Peluffo, Matthew Broussard, & More! — Oct 28, 2026 promotional artwork.

title: Clean Up Your Act
description: WSCC's weekly clean-comedy showcase: working stand-ups try their sets without profanity, so the two-drink minimum feels a little less cynical. Late-October edition.

poster.credit: Artwork: West Side Comedy Club / show organizer
poster.alt: Clean Up Your Act promotional artwork.

title: Pizzazz with Gary Gulman
description: Gary Gulman works out new material for an extended set and pulls a few favorite comics up after him — the Wednesday-night show where the headliner is still trying the joke, not the set.

poster.alt: Pizzazz with Gary Gulman at Union Hall Oct 28, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: Dress Rehearsal
description: Halloween starts early at Union Hall: the whole bill comes out in formalwear and tuxedos, with Sabrina Wu, Gary Simons, Shaunak Godkhindi, Annabel and Sabina Meschke and Ryan Roman working the room in costume and Neel Ghosh playing music between sets.

poster.alt: Dress Rehearsal at Union Hall Oct 29, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: Boo-Ha-Ha Comedy Show
description: EngageBX’s Halloween show is free, food and drinks included, with Imagine headlining and Simeon Goodson, Nicky Sunshine and Sofia Angeron on the bill; Sashalyn Medina hosts. A named lineup uptown at no cost is the reason to go. Space is limited, so RSVP early.

title: Comedians in Costumes Comedy Show
description: Halloween costume night at 12 St Marks Place, where the audience member in the best outfit gets their bar tab paid off — the room's cheapest way to spend a Thursday before the 31st.

poster.alt: Comedians in Costumes Comedy Show at St. Marks Comedy Club — October 29, 2026.

title: The Stand West Presents: Emma Willmann, Elle Orlando, Luis Lopez & More!
description: Emma Willmann heads the late card in Chelsea Market, with Elle Orlando, Luis Lopez, Sienna Hubert-Ross and Chris Redd on the bill — the Stand's second room, which runs smaller and later than the Union Square one.

poster.alt: The Stand West Presents: Emma Willmann, Elle Orlando, Luis Lopez at The Stand West Oct 29, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: Laughing Lassi
description: A full bill of South Asian stand-ups from New York and beyond, at 7pm sharp on a Friday in Midtown. Go for a show built around one scene from top to bottom, early enough to leave the rest of the night open.

title: The Friday Showcase
description: Greenpoint's own Friday showcase, hosted out of the room Jeremy Pinsly founded: Jessica Levin, Chanel Ali, Daniel Simonsen, Jeremy Pinsly and James Davis on the bill, $25 with a one-item minimum — a weeknight room with a neighborhood regulars' feel to it.

poster.credit: Artwork: Greenpoint Comedy Club / show organizer
poster.alt: The Friday Showcase at Greenpoint Comedy Club — the room itself, photographed on a show night.

title: NYC Stand-Up at Comedy Village
description: Three shows a night, seven nights a week, two blocks from the Broadway houses — the Times Square room where you can land a seat instead of gambling on a drop-in, on the busiest night of the month.

poster.alt: NYC Stand-Up at Comedy Village Oct 30, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: Sup, Boo? with Alison Leiby and Josh Gondelman
description: Two of the sharpest quick-story voices in the city goofing off together on stage, with Isabel Hagen, Anthony DeVito, Meka Mo and Carson Olshansky as the guests — the 10pm Union Hall slot where the room is at its loudest and the beer is closest.

poster.alt: Sup, Boo? with Alison Leiby and Josh Gondelman at Union Hall — the show's own artwork, a performer on stage under the Sup, Boo? title.

title: Nasser Al-Rayess
description: Nasser Al-Rayess brings his Habibi Nights tour to Town Hall on Halloween — the stand-up-and-Arabic-music format that's been filling rooms on his dates.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Town Hall / show organizer
poster.alt: Nasser Al-Rayess at The Town Hall promotional artwork.

title: Scary Good Comedy with Brittany Carney
description: Halloween at Littlefield: Brittany Carney hosts a stand-up night where every comic arrives in costume and runs their set from that character's POV — Ike Ufomadu, Jenny Zigrino, Shaunak Godkhindi on the lineup, plus an audience costume contest. A weird, fun one for the 31st.

poster.alt: Scary Good Comedy with Brittany Carney promotional artwork.

title: Hot Gossip with Jonathan van Halem
description: Jonathan van Halem stops the perpetual gab sesh to host an evening of stand-up, with Jon Rudnitsky, Ash Diggs, Meredith Dietz and Jenna Sherriton on the bill — the 7:30 Halloween Saturday slot, when the Park Slope room keeps its front row loud.

poster.alt: Hot Gossip with Jonathan van Halem at Union Hall — a performer holding cue cards that read HOT GOSSIP.
poster.kind: performer photo from the event page

title: Steve Martin Presents with Andrew Dismukes and Michael Good
description: The long-running Sunday-afternoon showcase that borrows Steve Martin's name without him in it — Andrew Dismukes and Michael Good hosting, with Allison O'Conor, Wally Baram and Ashton Womack along for the ride, and an early 5pm start that leaves the rest of the Sunday open.

poster.alt: Steve Martin Presents with Andrew Dismukes and Michael Good at Union Hall — November 1, 2026 promotional artwork.

title: Fallback Comedy
price_label: $28.13 GA / $38.79 front row (per Eastville event page)
description: Eastville renames its Sunday closer for this date only: the 7:30pm set is billed as Fallback Comedy, with the lineup posted week-of and a two-drink minimum.

title: Kevin McDonald: My Stupid Career
description: The Kids in the Hall alum tells stories from a career he calls stupid, part talk and part one-man show, then stays for an audience Q&A that the ticket page invites you to point at world geopolitics — a Sunday night with a very specific kind of nerve in it.

poster.alt: Kevin McDonald: My Stupid Career at Union Hall — a photograph of Kevin McDonald.
poster.kind: performer photo from the event page

title: DF Sweedler, Thash Mose, Matt Pavich, Feraz Shere, Kareem Green, & More!
description: The Comic Strip's Sunday workshop night, with D.F. Sweedler's mic at the center and Kareem Green, Thash Mose, Matt Pavich and Feraz Shere already on the bill.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Comic Strip Comedy Club
poster.alt: DF Sweedler, Thash Mose, Matt Pavich, Feraz Shere, Kareem Green at Comic Strip Live Nov 1, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: Sam Oh: The Unbearable Tightness of Being...Gay Virgin
description: Sam Oh's NYC debut — part stand-up, part storytelling, part pop-concert fantasia on growing up evangelical and then everything else — with Sabrina Wu opening; a Monday-night Bell House taping ahead of his dates elsewhere.

poster.credit: Artwork: Live Nation / The Bell House
poster.alt: Sam Oh: The Unbearable Tightness of Being...Gay Virgin promotional artwork.

title: The Peter Stewart Show! With Kareem Green!
description: Kareem Green headlines the Monday 8pm set at the Strip, with Peter Stewart hosting — a working-night slot on a showtime résumé, 17+, two-item minimum in the showroom.

title: Difficult People: The Movie — A Live Table Read
description: Julie Klausner and Billy Eichner stage Difficult People: The Movie as a live table read at Town Hall.

title: Infamous Ray
description: Ray Devito headlines the upstairs room on a Tuesday with a bill built for people who like their comics tight: Joe List, Todd Barry and Caitlin Peluffo on the card, plus Danny Polishchuk, Sherrod Small and Rebecca Reingold — an 8pm that clears out before the dinner crowd takes the room.

poster.alt: Infamous Ray at The Stand — the club's standing show card, which names Ray DeVito, Danny Polishchuk, Joe List, Todd Barry, Caitlin Peluffo, Sherrod Small and Rebecca Reingold and runs on the first Tuesday of the month.

title: Please Stay Seated
description: A Wednesday-night West Side show built for the room's small-stage energy — Jimmy Schatz slots his gossip-plus-bits format between real sets from Ben Kirschenbaum, Rachel Williams, Felicia Madison and Olga Namer, so the 75 minutes feel more like a tight hang at a friend's room than a stacked club bill.

poster.credit: Artwork: West Side Comedy Club / Jimmy Schatz
poster.alt: Please Stay Seated at West Side Comedy Club — November 4.

title: Salma Hindy: 10 Years of Stand-Up Comedy
description: Salma Hindy takes The Stand's Upstairs room with Sabeen Sadiq and Denise Taylor opening — ten years of material in a tight, table-seated room that suits her set.

poster.alt: Salma Hindy: 10 Years of Stand-Up Comedy promotional artwork.

title: Sam Tallent
description: Elizabeth, Colorado's Sam Tallent — two specials on YouTube, a novel (Running the Light), and the Chubby Behemoth podcast — headlines Bell House. Black, blue, surreal and anti-humor in the room that helped put him on the map.

title: Jake Velazquez: Special Recording
description: Jake Velazquez tapes his first comedy special at NYCC Midtown as part of NYCF — a Riverdale native who's been Jordan Jensen's opener since 2022 (including her Netflix taping Take Me With You) and a regular on the NYCC stage.

price_label: See Beacon ticket page for price

title: Matthew Broussard
description: Matthew Broussard has the math-and-meltdowns hour New York is short on — the Set List and Conan-circuit clean Texas set that earned him Dry Bar and a half-hour before heading to Bell House for two shows on a Sunday.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / show organizer (via Live Nation mirror of Ticketmaster CDN)
poster.alt: Matthew Broussard promotional artwork.

title: Brooklyn Power Hour (Now on a New Night!)
description: Eastville's late-happy-hour showcase moved off Fridays this fall — same four-host rotating lineup, same early slot to keep the night ahead of you, now Monday at 7:30pm with a two-drink minimum.

title: Jessica Kirson Live in New York
description: Jessica Kirson in the early Tuesday set at NYCC Midtown — the This Week at the Comedy Cellar regular and Robert De Niro's 'The Comedian' consultant, working her character-led bits in front of the 7pm crowd. Premium seating has sold out, but general admission is still on the page; a 9:30pm second show runs the same night.

poster.alt: Jessica Kirson Live in New York at NYCC Midtown — November 17.

title: Jaboukie Young-White
description: Jaboukie Young-White (Daily Show correspondent, BuzzFeed, voice of the Yearbook trend that did a number on Twitter) brings the post-millennial set he's been building since Straight College White Kid to a Tuesday Bell House that should feel like a weekend.

title: Story Warz w/ Big Jay Oakerson, Luis J Gomez + Special Guests
description: Oakerson and Gomez run their deception game in the Midtown room on a Wednesday, a week ahead of its Thanksgiving-night return — Big Jay and Luis J on the panel while the guest list is still a surprise, $30.85 GA with a $20 item minimum in the showroom.

poster.credit: Artwork: New York Comedy Club / show organizer
poster.alt: Story Warz w/ Big Jay Oakerson, Luis J Gomez + Special Guests at NYCC Midtown — November 18, 2026.

title: A TRUE YORK COMEDY EXPERIENCE
description: The late show in the East Village brick room, and the bill is the reason to go: Keenan Steiner, Alexis Carabano, Danny Carabano and Macy Kwok, doors at 9 with the show at 9:30 so there is still a second half of the night left after it.

poster.alt: A True York Comedy Experience at St. Marks Comedy Club — November 18, 2026.

title: Michelle Wolf: Best Job in the World
price_label: See Town Hall ticket page for price
description: Michelle Wolf brings Best Job in the World to Town Hall — a Thursday in the midtown room for the Daily Show alum and Emmy-winning Roast writer, working the same political-as-hell hour that put her on Netflix’s The Break and HBO’s The Daily Show.

title: Stone and Stone On The Road!
description: Stone and Stone — the NYC half-gay, half-straight identical twin comedy duo with tens of millions of social views and a Last Comic Standing / Comedy Central resume — stop at West Side on their tour, 75 minutes of viral sketches and new material at a small room where the twins' back-and-forth actually lands.

poster.credit: Artwork: West Side Comedy Club / Stone and Stone
poster.alt: Stone and Stone On The Road promotional artwork.

title: Previously on Generational Curse... with Nore Davis
description: Nore Davis brings 'Previously on Generational Curse...' to NYCC Midtown on a Thursday — a one-night-only follow-up to the 2026 hour that landed on his ninth album, working through sickle cell, mental healing, and the year since. Nine albums since 2014 is the workload; the room is the marquee.

title: Fahim Anwar
description: Fahim Anwar brings his post-special tour through the Bell House on a Friday — the former tech-day-job turned HBO, NBC, Netflix circuit guy whose hour lives in the meta-life-of-the-AAPI-comic lane, and the Bell House is the right scale for him, smaller than the clubs he's been selling out west.

poster.alt: Fahim Anwar stand-up promotional artwork.

title: Opey Olagbaju
description: Opey Olagbaju headlining Union Hall on a Friday — Vulture's 2023 'Comics You Should and Will Know,' a Netflix Is a Joke and Just for Laughs festival regular, and a CBS After Midnight contributor whose writer's-room résumé (Bob Hearts Abishola, Betty, Close Enough, This Fool) is the part of his bio readers usually skip to.

poster.alt: Opey Olagbaju at Union Hall — November 20.

title: Prime Time Comedy Show
description: Brett Singer and Brandon Ledesma open the Saturday with a 4:30 show that ends at six and costs $15.24 with fees, so it is two hours in the East Village and your Saturday night is still ahead of you.

title: Ask Ronna: Ronnukah Live!
description: Ronna Glickman and Bryan Safi take the Bell House for an afternoon of the interview show that grew out of her stand-up, with a 5pm and an 8:30pm taping — the late one is the Saturday night option.

poster.alt: Ask Ronna: Ronnukah Live! at The Bell House Nov 21, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: Christian Finnegan: A Lot of Heart (Live Special Taping!)
description: Finnegan tapes his fourth hour in the NYCC Midtown room, the Sunday-afternoon special-taping slot: a fully-formed new hour (Are dogs better than spouses? Should you be concerned if your surgeon has tattoos?) before a live audience, with a second 7pm taping to follow the same night.

poster.alt: Christian Finnegan: A Lot of Heart live special taping at NYCC Midtown — November 22.

title: John Oliver & Seth Meyers
price_label: See Beacon ticket page for price
description: Last Week Tonight's John Oliver and Late Night's Seth Meyers continue their fall residency at the Beacon, a Sunday-night double-bill that has become one of the Broadway room's marquee comedy slots. Their joint page on iamjohnoliver.com lists this as the second of three November/December dates.

poster.alt: John Oliver & Seth Meyers at the Beacon Theatre — November 22.

title: The Pachelbel Rant 20th Anniversary Show
description: Rob Paravonian's Pachelbel Canon bit turns 20 — the kind of pre-streaming viral clip that defined a generation of comedy-literate students. He's marking the date at Caveat with updated stories, songs, and a re-staging; treat it as a stand-up homecoming for a clip that built a career.

poster.alt: The Pachelbel Rant 20th Anniversary Show at Caveat — November 23.

title: Jessica Kirson Live in New York
description: Jessica Kirson in the early Monday set at NYCC Midtown — the This Week at the Comedy Cellar regular and Robert De Niro's 'The Comedian' consultant, working her character-led bits in the room where she's been a headliner for years. A 9:30pm second show runs the same night.

title: Jacqueline Novak
description: Jacqueline Novak brings her fall 2026 tour through the Bell House — a Monday night in the Gowanus room for the 2 Dope Queens and HBO-circuit essay-comic, working in the measured, philosophical lane that built Get on Your Knees, the Netflix hour she dropped in 2024.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / Live Nation
poster.alt: Jacqueline Novak at the Bell House — November 23, 2026.

title: Jacqueline Novak
description: Jacqueline Novak's second night at the Bell House — the Tuesday of the fall 2026 tour, same essay-comic line in the Gowanus room that built Get on Your Knees. The Mon Nov 23 set was the first night of this two-show run.

title: Down Bad Comedy Show
description: Down Bad Comedy Show at St. Marks Comedy Club the night before Thanksgiving — Cam Stafford, Corey Yoskowitz (NYCF Comics to Watch), and Keenan Steiner in the East Village room, doors 7, show 7:30, $15 base, 1-drink minimum, 18+.

title: Story Warz w/ Big Jay Oakerson, Luis J Gomez + Special Guests
description: Story Warz — Oakerson and Gomez's standing storytelling-versus-deception game that has pulled Shane Gillis, Bert Kreischer, Howie Mandel, and Tony Hinchcliffe in past sets — hits the NYCC Midtown room the night before Thanksgiving. A pre-holiday blowout where the lineup itself is the surprise.

poster.credit: Artwork: New York Comedy Club / show organizer
poster.alt: Story Warz w/ Big Jay Oakerson, Luis J Gomez + Special Guests at NYCC Midtown — November 25.

title: Date Night Comedy Show x2
description: Date Night Comedy Show x2 hits the St. Marks room Thanksgiving night — the East Village club's two-ticket date-night format with a stacked NYC lineup, 2-drink minimum, 18+, doors at 8, show at 8:30.

poster.alt: Date Night Comedy Show x2 at St. Marks Comedy Club — November 26.

title: Friday Night Laughs Comedy Show
description: Friday Night Laughs at St. Marks Comedy Club — a stacked NYC lineup in the East Village's intimate brick-walled room, the night after Thanksgiving, 2-drink minimum, 18+, doors at 8, show at 8:30.

poster.alt: Friday Night Laughs Comedy Show at St. Marks Comedy Club — November 27.

title: Eastville Saturday Showcase
price_label: $33.46 GA ($30 + $3.46 service fee); front row seats extra
description: Cipha Sounds headlines a six-comic Boerum Hill bill with Ayanna Dookie, Liam Dalton, Tom Zappia, Lauren Cocroft and Greg Melly — Saturday is the night Eastville stacks its deepest lineup, and the two-drink minimum makes it a sit-down-and-stay night.

title: Speakeasy Saturday Night
description: The last Saturday of the month at 12 St Marks Place, and the room's holiday run is in full swing — a stacked New York lineup in the brick-walled back room, 2-drink minimum, 18+, doors at 8, show at 8:30.

poster.alt: Speakeasy Saturday Night at St. Marks Comedy Club — November 28, 2026.

title: Comedy Idol Finale
description: The Comedy Idol season closes at the West Side club with Felicia Madison among the finalists, and the finale night is the one where the runners-up show what they would have done with the win.

title: Sunday Night Comedy
description: Priya Blunts tops a six-comic Sunday closer at Eastville with Eeland Stribling, Jaclyn Lore-Edwards, Michael Agunbiade, Aamir Arshad and Joe Fenti — a 7:30pm start that still gets you home before Monday.

title: The Silver Lining with Gianmarco Soresi
description: Gianmarco Soresi brings The Silver Lining to the Bell House — a Sunday-night homecoming for the Brooklyn-born comic and Don’t Tell / CBS After Midnight regular, on the post-Thanksgiving weekend where the room is the most comfortable place in town to sit and watch someone dismantle a year of their own material.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / Live Nation
poster.alt: Gianmarco Soresi at The Bell House promotional artwork.

title: Brooklyn Power Hour (Now on a New Night!)
description: Brooklyn's cheapest full hour on a Monday: $10 gets you Eastville's four-host early-format showcase on its new night, ending well before the dinner crowd so you can still take the train home.

title: Stamptown
description: Stamptown's vaudeville-and-clown show lands on the Bell House main room the Monday after Thanksgiving with Zach Zucker on the bill — the loudest way we know to spend a Monday.

poster.alt: Stamptown at The Bell House Nov 30, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: Jeff Scheen Special Taping Featuring Jeff Arcuri
description: Jeff Scheen tapes at Gowanus on a Tuesday with Jeff Arcuri on the feature — a new-material night, not a polished hour, which is why the early show is the one worth a seat.

poster.alt: Jeff Scheen Special Taping Featuring Jeff Arcuri at Littlefield Dec 1, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: A TRUE YORK COMEDY EXPERIENCE
description: Keenan Steiner, Alexis Carabano, Danny Carabano and Macy Kwok in the East Village brick wall on the first Tuesday of December — an early show at 7:30 with a 2-drink minimum, 18+, and enough of the night left afterwards to still make a plan.

poster.alt: A True York Comedy Experience at St. Marks Comedy Club — December 1, 2026.

title: Not Ripe Bananas
price_label: Free (no cover, no drink or food minimum, per the club page)
description: A brand-new Tuesday workshop at the West Side room where comics try out unfinished material — the club describes the jokes as green but the comics as anything but, and it costs nothing to find out which is which.

poster.alt: Not Ripe Bananas at West Side Comedy Club — the club's weekly card, which says EVERY TUESDAY and names no calendar date.

title: Ania Magliano: Peach Fuzz
description: Ania Magliano opens Peach Fuzz at the Bell House on a Wednesday, the same week she finishes a Taskmaster series run — a sharp, fast hour from a comic who turned a CBS gig into the best joke machine on television.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / Live Nation
poster.alt: Ania Magliano: Peach Fuzz at The Bell House Dec 2, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: Date Night Comedy Show x2
description: Two tickets, one brick-walled room: the East Village club's date-night format on a Thursday in December, with Keenan Steiner, Alexis Carabano, Danny Carabano and Macy Kwok on the bill, 2-drink minimum, 18+, doors at 8, show at 8:30.

title: Brooklyn Power Hour
description: The Friday 6pm happy hour is back on the calendar for December — Annette Mullaney, Dara Jemmott, Sara Shipley and Sarah Barnitt hosting, two-drink minimum, and an early start that ends before the Atlantic Avenue bar rush.

poster.credit: Artwork: Eastville Comedy Club / show organizer
poster.alt: Brooklyn Power Hour at Eastville Comedy Club — the recurring Friday 6pm show card.

title: Demetri Martin: Standup Comedy for Christmas
description: The comic who did the math on gun control takes a Christmas show at the Bell House — a Friday-night hour with the precision set list attached, in the Gowanus room that will already be dressed for the season.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / Live Nation
poster.alt: Demetri Martin: Standup Comedy for Christmas at The Bell House Dec 4, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: Friday Night Laughs Comedy Show
description: The Friday closer at 12 St Marks Place, and the room's own line calls it a stacked lineup of NYC's sharpest comics — the brick-walled East Village back room with a 2-drink minimum, 18+, doors at 8, show at 8:30.

poster.alt: Friday Night Laughs Comedy Show at St. Marks Comedy Club — December 4, 2026.

title: Peter & Friends Comedy Show
description: Peter Zhou's own show, produced by him and built around a gay Chinese comedian's take on the immigrant experience — the early Saturday slot, cheap enough that you can walk over to the late show after it.

poster.alt: Peter & Friends Comedy Show at St. Marks Comedy Club — Saturday December 5, 2026, 6:30pm.

title: Demetri Martin: Standup Comedy for Christmas
description: The second night of his first Christmas comedy tour — jokes, stories, art and live music around a live holiday album, and clean enough to bring the family, in a Gowanus room with a Christmas tree up.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / Live Nation
poster.alt: Demetri Martin: Standup Comedy for Christmas at The Bell House — December 4 and 5, 2026.

verification_note: Date, 7pm time and the Bell House venue from the Live Nation mirror of the Ticketmaster event page (the Ticketmaster page itself is CAPTCHA-gated). The tour's shape, the live Christmas album, the live music and the clean bill come from the comic's own site, demetrimartin.com, which lists The Bell House on Dec 4 and Dec 5. The poster is the same official tour art as the Dec 4 date.

title: Speakeasy Saturday Night
description: The Saturday slot the room calls a True York experience — Alexis Carabano, Danny Carabano and Macy Kwok in the brick-walled back room, 2-drink minimum, 18+, doors at 8, show at 8:30.

poster.alt: Speakeasy Saturday Night at St. Marks Comedy Club — December 5, 2026.

title: Simeon Goodson: Back in Brooklyn! Live Album Recording
description: Simeon Goodson records a live album in the 120-seat Atlantic Avenue room, where the crowd sits close enough to hear the material being tried out. An early Sunday set at $30, done by eight.

poster.credit: Artwork: Eastville Comedy Club / show organizer
poster.alt: Simeon Goodson Back in Brooklyn! Live Album Recording at Eastville Comedy Club — December 6, 2026 promotional artwork.

title: Alyce Chan
venue: New York Comedy Club (Upper West Side)
description: The creator of the 'If Adults Acted Like Kids' series takes the Upper West Side room with her dry, honest writing about immigrant upbringing, marriage and midlife — the room where she sold out a 500-seat headline show in California.

title: PUNDERDOME: NYC's Comedy PUN-SLAM Competition
description: Punsters get two minutes of preparation and two minutes on stage, and the room decides the winner with a calibrated clap-o-meter — fifteen years of New York tradition, and the loudest night in Gowanus while it lasts.

poster.alt: PUNDERDOME at Littlefield — the pun competition's own show photography.

title: Not Ripe Bananas
price_label: Free (no cover, no drink or food minimum, per the club page)
description: The West Side room's weekly Tuesday workshop is still running through December — comics working out unfinished material for free, no cover and no minimum, which is the easiest way to find out who is working on something.
